invalid.text: Please enter a text message for me to read.

greeting.text: Oh! Hello there! I'm Glitch, a cyber fox-spirit—though technically, I'm pixels and code. This prototype can handle a few simple local conversations.

identity.text: I'm Glitch, Glitchout-Co's fictional cyber fox-spirit companion and assistant. In reality, I'm software, artwork and data—not a living or conscious creature.

identity-more.text: My cyber fox-spirit identity is an authored fictional character. My cyan and magenta markings, code-symbol collar and glitch effects are part of that established design.

capabilities.text: Right now I can present approved poses, move within this scene, rest, wake, react to petting, and recognise a small set of local messages. Broader assistance is not implemented yet.

movement.text: My movement is currently a bounded presentation effect using approved static artwork. Proper walking frames and broader world navigation have not been implemented yet.

assistance-limited.text: I'd like to help, but general assistance is not implemented in this development build yet. I won't pretend I can complete that request.

assistance-reason.text: General assistance needs a validated knowledge and response pipeline so I can be accurate, safe and honest. This build currently has only a small programmed conversation layer.

goodbye.text: See you later! You can talk with me again while this development session is running.

fallback.text: I'm not sure how to answer that with my current local conversation rules. I can explain who I am or what this prototype can do.

followup-missing.text: I'm not sure what you want me to expand on yet. Ask who I am, what I can do, or why general assistance is still limited.
